answer_1.quote: We sample 50 inputs from GIGAWORD test... Every generated news is presented to 5 annotators on Amazon Mechanical Trunk (AMT). Annotators were presented with two news articles and asked to decide which one was better and which one was worse in order of grammar and fluency, coherence, and informativeness.

answer_2.quote: The performance is measured by standard corpus-level metrics, including BLEU, ROUGE.
